fields.briefDescription: Find and install reusable AI work guides. Creators publish Skills and receive agreed collaborator payouts through Solana.
fields.buildingAndAudience: A Skill is a package of instructions, templates and reference files for an AI assistant. SkillSeal helps developers find the complete package, install the version they chose, and recover a purchase. Creators upload a Skill, set its terms, agree on collaborator shares, and share a link after review. Free Skills need no wallet. Paid versions use Solana for payment, a version-specific purchase record and collaborator payouts. The first users are developers and creator teams who already use wallets. The website is live; paid purchase, 70/30 payouts, recovery and timeout refund passed on Devnet with test money. We have not validated customer demand or revenue.
fields.whyAndWhyNow: Useful AI workflows are often scattered across prompt links, folders and messages. A prompt alone may omit the template, references or checks needed to repeat a task. We want to make that work easy to package, deliver and reuse, while giving collaborators a clear way to receive their agreed shares. Solana fits teams already using wallets: purchase records and payouts can be inspected together. Traditional payments can also support this. Our next experiment is to observe developers using a Skill and measure whether it is useful enough to pay for, separating successful installation from actual demand.
fields.technologies: Solana; Anchor/Rust escrow program; SPL Token and Devnet USDC; TypeScript; Next.js 16 and React 19; Node.js 24; SQLite; AES-256-GCM; libsodium X25519 sealed boxes; @solana/web3.js; Phantom/Solflare wallet integration; pnpm; GitHub Actions. OpenAI Codex assisted implementation, review, tests, and documentation. The current prototype does not require an LLM API to buy or install a Skill.
fields.chainUsage: Solana is the payment and receipt layer. For a paid Skill, the program holds test USDC, then records access to the chosen version and pays the approved collaborator shares in one transaction. A completed purchase can be recovered without paying again. An unsettled payment is refundable after ten minutes. Public Devnet tests verified purchase, 70/30 payouts, recovery and refund. No mainnet money is collected.
fields.otherContributors: OpenAI Codex assisted with code generation, implementation review, tests, and documentation. The registered human team currently has one member. Any additional human contributor should be disclosed here before submission.
